forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: A cycle leaves no module that can be understood or tested first.

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: Every import resolves to a file or an installed package.

forbidden.name: not-to-undeclared
forbidden.comment: A package is imported only by a workspace package that declares it, never through a sibling's or the root's installation.

forbidden.name: no-duplicate-dependency-types
forbidden.comment: A package is declared as exactly one kind of dependency.

forbidden.name: production-not-to-development-dependency
forbidden.comment: What a provider synthesizes from may not import a development-only package.

forbidden.name: source-not-to-entry-point
forbidden.comment: A provider's app entry point composes its sources; nothing imports it.

forbidden.name: constructs-not-to-composition
forbidden.comment: A construct is composed by a stack or record, never the reverse.

forbidden.name: provider-not-to-another-package
forbidden.comment: A provider package reaches another workspace package only through a declared dependency, never by a relative path.

forbidden.name: tooling-not-to-provider
forbidden.comment: Workspace tooling serves every provider and depends on none.
